_comment: Performance baseline for the CI REGRESSION gate (plan 6.2). Re-based 2026-08-14 (third calibration) after CI run 31751283978: rehearsal on the shared runner measured 6182 ms (vs 4000 budget -> relative FAIL), so lh_2000_rehearsal_ms budget raised to 10000. Confirmed CI numbers from that run: load insert 1089 rec/s, load search 111 ms, lh insert 11278 rec/s, sla_startup 143 ms, sla_context 97 ms - all within their budgets. Values are CI-runner budgets with headroom; the relative check fails only when a metric regresses >25% below these budgets. Absolute catastrophe gates live in the bench binaries. Metrics below 5 ms are exempt from the relative check: their absolute GATE already fails the bench, and relative comparison on sub-5 ms values is pure noise.
